resources.string: Download it from the releases page; it installs over this one and keeps everything.
Allow Opensolr Photos to install updates, then tap the button again.
The download is not a valid Opensolr Photos update.
The update could not be installed. Try again.
Over disk or bandwidth, it stops. Out of AI requests, photos are indexed without words.
A tap you can feel when you pick photos, cross a month on the scroll bar, or change a filter.
The app follows your phone\'s language when it speaks it, and English otherwise.

A new photo without a position takes the place of the phone photo closest to it in time (within 30 minutes), or, if taken in the last 2 hours, the phone\'s own position. Photos that already have one are never touched.
Without location access only the phone\'s own photos are used. Allow location for the app to use the phone\'s position as well.

Android lets the app know the phone\'s position only while it is open, so photos synced in the background get only the place of the phone\'s own photos. Allow \"all the time\" in the app\'s location permission to change that.
Save the places into the photos
Controls how much keyword matching contributes vs. semantic meaning.
Your plan\'s AI requests for this month are used up, so search matches words only and this has no effect until they reset.
Your plan does not include search by meaning, so search matches words only and this has no effect.
Answers from your index are kept on this phone and reused, so the same question is not paid for twice. Your own tags, deleted photos and every finished sync empty it at once.
Reuse an answer for this many seconds
At least %1$s seconds, at most a day. In force: %2$s seconds.
Syncing stops and this phone forgets your Opensolr account. Your index and the photos in it stay in your account.
